description: This file defines the class 'bugzillaxmlrpcInterface' which extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and provides methods for interacting with Bugzilla via XML-RPC, including connecting, retrieving issues, creating issues, and configuration handling.

classes.name: bugzillaxmlrpcInterface
classes.description: A class for integrating with Bugzilla via XML-RPC, providing methods for issue management and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets default configurations, and connects to Bugzilla.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes configuration with default values if missing.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the bug ID has a valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to Bugzilla via XML-RPC.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Gets the status code of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Gets the verbose status of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the issue summary as an HTML string.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug ID exists in Bugzilla.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific product from Bugzilla.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new bug in Bugzilla.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Checks if issue creation via API is possible.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs into Bugzilla and retrieves a user token.
